title: TFT Tactician’s Superbrawl schedule, prize pool, stream, and more
content:
Riot Games has revealed more details about the Teamfight Tactics (TFT) Tactician’s Superbrawl. Read on for the TFT Tactician’s Superbrawl rundown, schedule, prize pool, and more.

This four-versus-four (4v4) TFT tournament will kick off on Nov. 6 and run until Nov. 8. The event will begin with 64 teams duking it out in 32 matches. The winners will advance to Round 2, where they’ll meet 32 other teams with byes.

Then, Tactician’s Superbrawl 2026 Day 2 will whittle the 32 teams down to 16 and then eight before Day 3’s semifinals and grand finals. Both finalists will qualify for Week 2 of TFT Set 19 ‘s Tactician’s Trials 1.

According to Riot Games, a total of 64 players them will begin in Round 1 while 32 will start with the aforementioned bye in Round 2 . Aside from the sub-regional winners, the other spots will be earned through a ladder snapshot.

The TFT esports action will begin on Nov. 6 at 2 a.m. PT for the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region. The Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region will then follow at 6 a.m. PT before the Americas (AMER) at 12 p.m. PT. The start times for Days 2 and 3 will be the same.

Folks will be able to watch the Tactician’s Superbrawl event on the game’s official Twitch channel.

title: How to get Point Blank Kills in Modern Warfare 4
content:
There are some weapon camo challenges throughout Call of Duty history that give players the most trouble. In Modern Warfare 4 , several of these camo challenges have returned, including getting Point Blank Kills. These types of kills have long been a thorn in the side of camo grinders, but there are ways to make getting Point Blanks much easier in multiplayer.

Below, we’ll go through how to get Point Blank Kills and the best ways to go about doing so in Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer.

For starters, a Point Blank Kill is earned when you eliminate an enemy that is in extremely close proximity to you. It doesn’t matter when you damage an enemy, but when you see the kill pop up in the killfeed, you need to be within a certain range of the enemy for it to count as a Point Blank.

The exact range for a Point Blank Kill in Modern Warfare 4 is currently unknown, but we do know that it’s much closer than you might expect. In most cases, you need to be within roughly two meters of an enemy when you kill them to earn a Point Blank. This goes for all weapon classes as well, so unlike Longshot Kills , you have to be roughly two meters away even if you’re using something like a light machine gun or sniper rifle.

Now that you understand what a Point Blank Kill is, what’s the most optimal way to go about earning them in multiplayer? Well, it slightly depends on the gun you’re using, as some weapons are naturally stronger at closer ranges.

However, for the most part, you’ll want to use mobility attachments on your loadout so you can get your gun up quicker, which helps out tremendously when killing enemies at close-range. You could also go for an entirely hip-fire build and just shoot from the hip when killing enemies up close. This works best for most weapons, but you can ADS with something like an SMG or assault rifle and have the same results.

Worlds 2026 : Reapered et la Karmine Corp n’ont peur de personne… ou presque
content:
La Karmine Corp se retrouve dos au mur après sa défaite face à Bilibili Gaming, lundi soir. Pourtant, comme contre LYON quelques jours plus tôt, les Français ont longtemps semblé capables de faire tomber leur adversaire avant de craquer dans les affrontements décisifs. Interrogé par Sheep Esports , Kim « Reapered » Han-gyu estime que son équipe doit avant tout progresser dans les teamfights. « BLG a simplement été meilleur que nous dans les teamfights en fin de partie. La veille, LYON nous avait également surpassés dans ces situations. Nous devons donc nous concentrer sur cet aspect. »

Pour le technicien sud-coréen, ces défaites se jouent toutefois sur des détails infimes plutôt que sur un véritable écart de niveau. « Dans ces moments critiques, un seul clic peut tout décider. Lors du dernier teamfight, si le Q de Nautilus ne touche pas Jhin, nous pouvons les écraser. » Une frustration d’autant plus grande que la KC avait pris l’avantage face à LYON et longtemps tenu tête à BLG. Reapered refuse néanmoins de remettre en question les qualités de ses joueurs, convaincu qu’ils possèdent les armes nécessaires pour mieux négocier ces situations. Le passage aux BO3 pourrait également jouer en faveur des Français, habitués à ce format en LEC.

Défaite face à BLG Ça se joue à des détails, mais ces détails comptent beaucoup au niveau mondial… 1-2 en Swiss Stage mais on ne lâche rien. Place maintenant aux BO3 pour aller décrocher notre qualification ! #KCORP pic.twitter.com/EUnwGknxKH

Avec un bilan de 1-2, la Karmine Corp devra désormais remporter deux BO3 consécutifs pour rejoindre les quarts de finale. Une mission difficile, mais loin d’être impossible aux yeux de son entraîneur. « Nous allons de toute façon affronter des équipes à 1-2, donc nous devrions être capables de battre n’importe laquelle d’entre elles » , assure Reapered. Fort de ses précédentes expériences aux Worlds avec Cloud9, il insiste également sur l’importance de conserver un état d’esprit positif plutôt que de sombrer dans la frustration après deux rencontres serrées.

Mais lorsqu’on lui demande quelle équipe il aimerait affronter au prochain tour, Reapered laisse échapper une réponse aussi courte qu’amusante : « N’importe qui sauf HLE. » Un souhait finalement exaucé par le tirage au sort, puisque la Karmine Corp retrouvera CTBC Flying Oyster ce jeudi 29 octobre à 21h. Les Français évitent ainsi Hanwha Life Esports, champion du MSI 2026, qui affrontera G2 Esports dans un autre BO3 éliminatoire. Un tirage relativement favorable sur le papier, même si CFO a déjà prouvé sa capacité à surprendre en battant Team Liquid lors de la première journée.

Au-delà de ce prochain rendez-vous, Reapered refuse de se fixer un objectif précis pour la suite de la compétition. « Peu importe que nous atteignions les quarts, les demi-finales, la finale ou que nous remportions les Worlds. Nous serons heureux de notre parcours et fiers de nous. » Avant d’ajouter : « Si nous devons perdre, je veux que ce soit contre les futurs champions du monde. » Un état d’esprit ambitieux que la KC devra désormais traduire sur le serveur, sous peine de voir son aventure mondiale s’arrêter prématurément.

title: Alberta iGaming market records $2.81 billion in wagers since launch
content:
The Alberta iGaming Corporation (AiGC) has published a new market report, revealing that about $2.81 billion in wagers were placed during the first 11 weeks of the province’s regulated iGaming market.

According to the report, which covers July 13 to Sept. 30, Alberta’s regulated iGaming market generated approximately $2.81 billion in wagers and about $122.1 million in gross gaming revenue (GGR) .

The market launched with 15 operators running 22 online casino or sports betting sites, expanding to 24 operators and more than 30 platforms by the end of September. Betting includes traditional sports, esports, and novelty betting products with options such as single-event wagers, live-action betting, pools and parlays.

Active player accounts also increased from 226,959 to 388,585 during the reporting period, generating an average of $146 in revenue per player.

“Early results indicate that Albertans value the strong oversight and greater accountability offered by a regulated market,” AiGC CEO Dan Keene said. “We hope to continue educating Albertans about the risks associated with illegal offshore sites and move them onto regulated platforms where they have rights and recourse when iGaming.”

Keene continued, “Regulation matters. This is a market where approved iGaming operators are held to high standards of accountability, and where revenue stays in the province to fund programs and services Albertans rely upon.”

title: Aleksib Suspended Sentence Explained: What the Tax Fraud Verdict Means for NAVI’s Captain
content:
Aleksib has been given a four-month suspended prison sentence after a Finnish district court convicted the NAVI captain of aggravated tax fraud, Finnish media reported on October 27, 2026. The case covered more than €53,000 of Counter-Strike sticker income from Valve that was left off his 2019 tax return. He will not go to prison unless the suspension is broken.

The sentence matches what the prosecutor asked for and sits at the bottom of the legal range for the offence. Here is what Aleksib was found guilty of, what his defence argued and what the verdict means for his career.

Aleksi “Aleksib” Virolainen, 29, was convicted of aggravated tax fraud over income he received from Valve in the 2019 tax year. According to the charges heard at the Eastern Uusimaa District Court, he did not return his pre-filled 2019 tax return, and the Valve payments were missing from it.

The prosecution said that left more than €53,000 of taxable income undeclared and caused his income tax to be assessed more than €28,000 too low. The offence period in the charge runs from May 19 to September 22, 2020, in Vantaa, the window in which the 2019 return was handled.

The money came from Counter-Strike sticker sales. At Valve’s Majors, players and teams get a share of revenue from in-game stickers sold in their name. In 2019, Aleksib played two Majors with ENCE and reached the grand final of IEM Katowice 2019.

No, not under this verdict. A suspended sentence means the prison term is not served as long as the person meets the conditions the court sets and does not commit a new offence during the probation period. The verdict reports we reviewed did not say how long Aleksib’s probation period is.

title: RLCS : AcroniK prend sa retraite à seulement 21 ans
content:
Une page se tourne sur la scène européenne de Rocket League. Bruno Alexandre « AcroniK » dos Santos Lopes a officialisé sa retraite sportive à seulement 21 ans, dans un court message publié sur les réseaux sociaux. « Je sais que ce ne sont pas les meilleurs mots pour annoncer une retraite, mais honnêtement, je n’ai pas envie d’écrire un long texte pour dire que j’arrête. Merci à tous. On se retrouve pour le prochain chapitre ! » , a confié le Portugais, sans donner davantage de détails sur ses futurs projets.

C’est surtout sous les couleurs de Team Liquid qu’AcroniK s’est fait un nom, en accompagnant l’éclosion de deux jeunes prodiges : Tristan « Atow » Soyez et Oskar « Oski » Gozdowski. Recrutés en février 2022 alors qu’ils n’avaient que 14 ans, les deux joueurs ont rapidement formé avec lui l’un des trios les plus redoutables d’Europe. Ensemble, ils ont remporté deux tournois régionaux, participé à cinq LAN internationales et atteint le dernier carré des Worlds 2023. Une aventure qui reste aujourd’hui le sommet de la carrière du Portugais, considéré comme le joueur le plus accompli de son pays sur Rocket League.

Après la séparation du trio en 2023, AcroniK n’a jamais vraiment retrouvé les mêmes résultats. Il s’est néanmoins illustré chez Luna Galaxy, avec notamment une deuxième place lors d’un tournoi régional des RLCS 2024, après une courte défaite face à BDS (3-4). Plus récemment, il avait rejoint NOVO Esports pour la saison 2026, disputant plusieurs tournois régionaux avant de représenter le Portugal aux championnats continentaux FIFAe, où sa sélection a atteint le top 8.

AcroniK quitte ainsi la scène professionnelle après sept années de compétition et six LAN des RLCS disputées au total. Il rejoint une liste de joueurs ayant récemment annoncé leur retraite, parmi lesquels ApparentlyJack, Comm, Stake et LuiisP. Si son palmarès ne reflète pas forcément toute son influence, le Portugais laisse derrière lui un héritage important, notamment pour son rôle dans l’éclosion d’Atow et Oski, aujourd’hui encore présents au plus haut niveau.

title: Nemiga’s in-game leader robo finds his aim in a 2-0 that knocks DENDELE out of Bucharest

He left it as the top fragger on the server, 35-24, as Nemiga took DENDELE’s own Nuke pick 13-3 and Ancient 13-6 to stay alive on two wins and two losses. Their first Major invitation since 2025 is now settled.

Two days of near misses had defined Nemiga in Bucharest. After a sweep of Legacy in the opening round, they lost four maps in a row, two of them by two rounds: 11-13 on Mirage against BetBoom and 14-16 in overtime on the same map against Aurora, a map they had led 11-8. robo is not a caller who sits back. He takes many of Nemiga’s entries himself and does not shy away from duels with players who are mechanically stronger. On Nuke he went 17-12, and on Ancient, where Nemiga started on the T side, he was 14-6 in the first half alone, finishing the map 18-12.

He was not alone. KaiR0N- went 22-5 with 119.7 ADR on Nuke. title: Valve tells indie developers to beat AI clones with community and steady Steam updates
content:
Valve's Steam Business Team told developers worried about AI-made clone games to stop worrying and to instead put that energy into building a community and shipping regular updates. By doing so, they will build the kind of rapport and goodwill with gamers that cloned games can’t compete with. The advice came at the Steam Indie Connect event on Oct. 27, and it’s especially prevalent for indie studios who currently have to sit back and watch as low-effort releases flood the market.

The event was co-hosted by Valve , the Busan Indie Connect Festival Organizing Committee, and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA). Tom Giardino and Marc Wilkinson of the Steam Business Team presented, and Matt from Valve's localization team joined the Q&A.

Brutal reality of making 500K on Steam as a game dev https://t.co/pYEd0Hxd1U

Valve's argument is simple: yes, a single mechanic can be cloned quickly, but the core features that foster a genuine connection with players can’t be copied the same way. Making the genuine version the best version has long been Valve's guiding principle, the team said. If developers renew their efforts here, they can only lose to better games that are also made by humans.

On the use of AI itself, Giardino was adamant that he won’t tell developers what they can and can’t do. It’s entirely up to them. "We don't want to be gatekeepers telling developers which tools they should or shouldn't use," he said. Whether to use AI in development, in Valve's view, is the developer's call.

One developer in the Q&A asked about extortion-style emails threatening to clone a game with AI and release it first. Giardino said it was the first time he'd heard of such cases and expressed his regret.

However, players hoping for a massive, top-tier Premium collection might need to temper their expectations. Given that Riot recently dropped the highly anticipated Popmons bundle, it is highly unlikely that they will release another massive, full-fledged Premium tier collection immediately back-to-back.

If Riot wants to provide something unique without committing to a full four-weapon skinline, a new Capsule is the most logical choice.

Similar to previous event-specific drops or the highly successful VCT Team Capsules, a smaller capsule release would bridge the gap perfectly. This format allows the developers to inject fresh, highly themed cosmetics—like unique player cards, gun buddies, and a single stylized weapon or melee—into the ecosystem without overshadowing recent major releases.

title: Valve on Steam AI Slop: No AI Filter, and AI Clone Extortion Is a Police Matter
content:
Valve has answered indie developers worried about Steam AI slop and AI clone extortion, and its answer is clear: there will be no gatekeeping of AI tools and no AI filter for now. Speaking at Steam Indie Connect in Seoul on October 27, 2026, Valve’s Steam team said clones existed long before AI, extortion is a police matter, and Next Fest’s random first two days will keep surfacing some low-quality games.

The session was a closed Q&A with Korean indie developers, co-hosted by the Busan Indie Connect Festival Organizing Committee and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA). Tom Giardino and Marc Wilkinson from the Steam business team took the questions, with a member of Valve’s localization team joining later. The answers below come from that session. Valve’s remarks were interpreted into Korean on site and later translated back into English, so quoted wording may differ slightly from what was said.

Valve’s position fits in four points. It will not police which development tools studios use, AI included. It sees AI clones as an old problem that AI has sped up. It treats extortion as a crime for law enforcement, while promising to look at cases developers report. And it admits the Next Fest format lets weak games through, without announcing a fix.

Giardino’s advice to developers worried about copycats was to build a community and keep updating the game. He tied that to Valve’s long-standing approach to piracy: avoid aggressive DRM and make the legitimate version the best version.

Since late September 2026, several indie developers have shared emails threatening to clone their unreleased games with AI and launch the copy on Steam first unless they pay. The reported demand in the known cases is about $200.

content:
The DMZ duplication glitch has led Infinity Ward to begin enforcement action against Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 players. The announcement came through the official Call of Duty Updates account on X on October 26, 2026. It says item duplication glitches and intentional exploit abuse break the Terms of Service. Below, you can read what the announcement says, which penalties the Security and Enforcement Policy allows, how the exploit affects DMZ, and what remains unconfirmed.

Infinity Ward is taking enforcement action against Modern Warfare 4 players who used the DMZ duplication glitch. The studio says item duplication glitches and intentional exploit abuse violate the Terms of Service. It has started enforcement against accounts found exploiting these issues.

Call of Duty: #ModernWarfare4 | #DMZ Item duplication glitches and the intentional abuse of exploits violate our Terms of Service. We’re beginning to take enforcement action against accounts found exploiting these issues.

title: Spirit Survive FURIA Comeback to Reach 2-1 Pool in Bucharest
content:
Team Spirit have moved into the 2-1 pool at PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 after surviving a difficult three-map battle against FURIA.

Spirit won the series 2-1, taking Nuke 13-7 before FURIA responded with a 13-8 victory on Ancient. The deciding Mirage then went down to the final rounds, where Spirit recovered from an 11-9 deficit to close the map 13-11.

Danil “donk” Kryshkovets once again led the way, finishing the series with 59 kills and a 1.46 rating as Spirit continued their recovery from an opening-round loss to BETBOOM.

Spirit looked comfortable on the opening map.

donk consistently found early advantages while Dmitry “sh1ro” Sokolov made life difficult for FURIA around Outside. Spirit established a 7-3 advantage during the first half and rarely looked under serious pressure.

After winning the second-half pistol and the following conversion, the Brazilian side tied the map at 7-7. Spirit immediately responded, however, winning six consecutive rounds to finish Nuke 13-7.

content:

The victory gives BETBOOM a perfect 3-0 record in the Swiss Stage following earlier wins over Spirit and Nemiga. NAVI, meanwhile, drop into the 2-1 pool and now face another difficult qualification opportunity against Vitality.

BETBOOM entered Bucharest with momentum after reaching the final of the Thunderpick World Championship, where they finished runner-up to FURIA.

Their route to the playoffs now includes victories over three very different opponents:

The result puts BETBOOM alongside FUT as one of the first teams to complete the Swiss Stage with a flawless 3-0 record.

BETBOOM are no longer simply producing isolated upsets — their recent results are starting to look like sustained top-level form.

title: DENDELE stun G2 and send them out of PGL Masters Bucharest at 0-3
content:
G2 Esports have been eliminated from PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 without winning a single series after suffering a surprise 2-1 defeat against DENDELE in the 0-2 elimination pool.

The Brazilian squad dominated Nuke, survived a G2 comeback on Ancient and then closed the series convincingly on Inferno. The result keeps DENDELE alive in Bucharest while ending a difficult tournament for G2 after losses to Natus Vincere, Aurora and now DENDELE.

G2 initially showed some promise on Nuke after winning an early force-buy, but their defensive start quickly unraveled.

DENDELE took control of the map and repeatedly found openings against an international lineup that struggled to establish a consistent structure. G2’s problems became even more obvious after the side switch, when they failed to win a single T-side round.

Ancient initially appeared to be heading in the same direction.

content:

title: shalfey Ready for GamerLegion Comeback After 16 Months Away

title: What Happened to SkylineTV? Adam Wolke’s Last Stream, Hospital Weeks and Tributes
content:
What happened to SkylineTV? Adam Wolke, the German IRL streamer behind the channel, died in October 2026 after a ruptured brain aneurysm caused a severe brain haemorrhage. Jens “Knossi” Knossalla and Verena Ullrich announced his death on Instagram on October 20. Ullrich later told her Twitch viewers he had spent about three weeks in hospital before he died.

That last detail changes how the story reads. The first wave of coverage made it sound sudden. German follow-ups since then show a slower picture: a final stream in late September where he talked about strange symptoms, weeks in hospital that close friends kept private, and then the announcement. Here is everything confirmed so far, what is only reported, and where the facts still conflict.

Wolke suffered a severe brain haemorrhage after an aneurysm in his brain ruptured. That cause comes straight from the joint statement that Knossi shared on his Instagram account with Verena Ullrich, who several German outlets describe as Wolke’s girlfriend. The pair said they stayed at his side until the end, called themselves deeply shaken and asked fans to respect the privacy of his family and closest friends.

Wolke’s management confirmed the death when asked, according to Bild and the dpa news agency. Knossi added a short line of his own under the post: “We will never forget you, you are irreplaceable!”

No funeral details have been made public. Given the privacy request, that is unlikely to change, and TalkEsport will not speculate about it.

We pieced this together from the Instagram statement and from what Ullrich, Knossi and Zarbex have said on their own streams, as reported by German media. Dates marked “reported” have not been confirmed by the family or management.

title: Pokémon UNITE Shutdown Reportedly Set for March 2027: What Players Should Know
content:
Popular Pokémon game known as Pokémon UNITE is shutting down, and the game will be taken offline according to reports. Following its release for Switch in July 2021, the game’s popularity saw a massive rise with its release for mobile devices in September 2021. Its unique take on Pokémon helped attract players, which eventually led to a massive player base.

According to Pokémon Company , the developers will be taking the game down on March 23, 2027. However, there is no official confirmation regarding the shutdown schedule, in-game purchases, and account-related changes.

Preparing for the end of service will be difficult, especially in light of the Aeos Crown 2027 tournament set to take place in Tokyo following Pokémon UNITE’s removal from the highly anticipated 2027 Pokémon World Championships. With no reports of the aforementioned event’s cancellation, it can be inferred that the competitive scene continues to be significant for the developers.

title: Call of Duty Passes $40 Billion in Lifetime Revenue With Modern Warfare 4 Launch
content:
Only a few days following the launch of Modern Warfare 4, the Call of Duty franchise has surpassed a whopping $40 billion USD in lifetime revenue, marking an incredible milestone for one of the most successful gaming series of all time.

The news came from Xbox CEO Asha Sharma herself, who confirmed this in an X announcement on October 26, shortly after the release of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. In case you missed it, MW4 came out on October 23 for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

“One of the most celebrated Call of Duty games in its 24-year history, and now $40B in lifetime franchise revenue,” Sharma said in a statement. “An incredible milestone. Congrats to the Activision team. And to the players, thank you for being with us.”

One of the most celebrated Call of Duty games in its 24-year history, and now $40B in lifetime franchise revenue. An incredible milestone. Congrats to the Activision team. And to the players, thank you for being with us. pic.twitter.com/AlpXydEQIQ

The number goes on to prove just how far the series has grown, especially within the past few years. In 2020, Activision had confirmed that the lifetime sales for the franchise were hovering around the $27 billion mark. By 2022, it had passed $30 billion, with approximately 425 million units being sold. Data-based estimates in 2024 placed it at roughly $35 billion across game sales, microtransactions, and subscriptions.

This means that about $10 billion in revenue was added over the course of the past four years.

title: Benched by G2 in June, SunPayus now has FUT saving their money for his AWP
content:
Three months on the bench ended for SunPayus when FUT Esports signed him on 1 October. Three series into his first event with the team, FUT are 3-0 at PGL Masters Bucharest, he has the best kill-death difference on the roster, and he says the young side treat him in a way his previous teams did not.

SunPayus spoke to PGL’s broadcast on Monday, minutes after FUT Esports came back from 4-8 on Anubis to beat Vitality 2-1 and become the first team through to the playoffs. Asked why it had worked so quickly, he said he had told coach coolio that nothing should change on his account. He wanted to adapt and be himself. What surprised him was how the team responded.

Everyone in the team is like, it didn’t pass in my past teams, but they treat me as a star player also. So it’s a bit weird.

On eco rounds, he explained, his teammates make do with Deagles and keep their money so that he has an AWP in the next round. They also listen when he speaks up in reviews and about specific situations, and he said they learn “super fast”.

The Spaniard came to FUT from G2, who signed him from HEROIC in June 2025 and moved him to the bench on 25 June this year, shortly after the IEM Cologne Major. r1nkle took over as G2’s AWPer. It was the second time in two years that SunPayus lost his place: Falcons benched him in September 2024, nine months after signing him from ENCE.

He did not blame the G2 environment when he was asked whether FUT’s young lineup felt different from the experienced players he had left.

title: jL meets his old team, and Aleksib says NAVI never celebrated their Singapore place
content:
Four of the five NAVI players Vitality face for a playoff place at PGL Masters Bucharest on Tuesday lifted the Copenhagen Major trophy with jL in 2024. Aleksib , iM , b1t and w0nderful won it with him, and all four are still in the lineup. HLTV ranked jL as the fifth-best player of 2024.

The split came gradually. jL took a voluntary break in July 2025, spent April and May of this year on loan at MOUZ , and became a free agent when he left NAVI on 1 July after three years. Six matches for Vitality at BLAST Open Porto followed, and so did a clear answer to the question of a return. On the BLAST analysis desk in September, he said NAVI looked too static and were “trying to play too perfect CS”, and that he had not left in order to come back.

Vitality did not meet NAVI in Porto, so Tuesday is the first time he lines up against them.

jL is in Bucharest because apEX is at home for the birth of his child, and the count matters beyond this event. Valve’s Regional Standings only list players who have played five of a team’s last ten matches, so five matches in Bucharest would put jL in apEX’s place on the roster Vitality are invited with to PGL Major Singapore. We explained the rule before the event .

title: Roaring Bears will leave their colours at home for IEM Cologne 2027 over ESL’s ticket prices
content:
Roaring Bears, the German fan club known for its organised support at BIG’s matches, will not appear as a group at IEM Cologne 2027. The club blames ESL’s ticket pricing and what it calls the growing commercialisation of the event, and it has asked fans who still go to the LANXESS Arena to leave its merchandise at home.

The decision came on Monday evening, three and a half weeks after the club first said it was considering staying away. It is not a call for a boycott. Roaring Bears stress that every fan can decide for themselves whether to travel to Cologne, and that some of their own members may still make the trip. What disappears is the organised, recognisable block in the stands. The statement, posted in German and English:

After careful consideration, we the Roaring Bears have made a decision: we will not be attending as the Roaring Bears in a recognizable fashion. We want to make it clear that we will not tell anyone whether they should attend IEM or travel to Cologne, nor will we judge anyone for doing so. That is everyone’s own decision, and we respect that. However, under the current circumstances, we do not feel comfortable attending the event as usual.

No Bears at #IEM Cologne 2027 Link zum Text in den Kommis 🔽 Text below 🔽 pic.twitter.com/mxNI9vgkmQ

The club is considering an alternative programme, but nothing has been decided yet. Its one request goes to everyone who does attend:

If you attend the event at the LANXESS Arena, please refrain from wearing Roaring Bears merchandise. We do not want our name and colors to be represented at an event whose current ticket pricing and increasing commercialization we strongly criticize. We believe that Counter-Strike should be accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford increasingly expensive tickets.

title: Worlds 2026 : la Karmine Corp épargnée par le tirage, deux monstres pour KOI et G2 !
content:
Après trois journées riches en surprises, le Swiss Stage entre dans une phase décisive. La Karmine Corp peut notamment s’estimer relativement chanceuse après le tirage au sort de ce quatrième tour. Battus successivement par LYON et Bilibili Gaming, les Français retrouveront CTBC Flying Oyster, formation taïwanaise également en 1-2, ce jeudi 29 octobre à 21h. Un adversaire qui semble plus abordable sur le papier que certains autres prétendants, mais qui avait notamment créé la surprise face à Team Liquid en ouverture du tournoi. Pour Caliste et ses coéquipiers, l’équation est simple : une victoire pour rester en vie, une défaite et l’aventure mondiale prendra fin.

Le tirage a été nettement moins clément avec Movistar KOI et G2 Esports. Toujours en course pour une qualification directe en quarts de finale avec un bilan de 2-1, les Espagnols devront affronter T1, champion du monde en titre, dès mercredi à 21h. Un défi immense pour la bande à Elyoya, qui reste sur une lourde défaite contre Dplus KIA. De son côté, G2 n’aura pas le droit à l’erreur face à Hanwha Life Esports, champion du MSI 2026 et autre grand favori de la compétition. Les deux équipes, actuellement en 1-2, joueront leur survie dans un BO3 programmé le 30 octobre à minuit, dans la nuit de vendredi.

Dans les autres rencontres du tableau à 2-1, Invictus Gaming affrontera LYON, tandis que Top Esports retrouvera Bilibili Gaming dans un choc 100 % chinois. Les vainqueurs de ces trois BO3 rejoindront Gen.G et Dplus KIA en quarts de finale, alors que les perdants devront disputer un cinquième et dernier tour pour tenter de se qualifier.

Enfin, le tableau des équipes en 1-2 proposera également une confrontation entre Team Liquid et LOS, deux formations qui ont sauvé leur peau lors de la troisième journée. Comme pour la Karmine Corp et G2, la moindre défaite sera synonyme d’élimination. Ce quatrième tour pourrait donc déjà sceller le sort de plusieurs grands noms de la compétition, avant l’ultime journée du Swiss Stage.

Toutes les rencontres se disputeront en BO3.

The #Worlds2026 Swiss Stage Bracket after today's matches! Note: The match order is still TBD. pic.twitter.com/5NBnQkP2Sy

title: Worlds 2026 : la Karmine Corp dos au mur, Anyone’s Legend éliminé en 0-3
content:
T1 a ouvert les hostilités face à CTBC Flying Oyster. Malgré une bonne entame des Taïwanais, les champions du monde en titre ont rapidement pris le contrôle des affrontements collectifs. Avec un Faker cantonné au rôle de tank sur Galio (2/1/8), les Sud-Coréens ont conclu la rencontre en seulement 27 minutes. Une victoire qui porte leur bilan à 2-1 et les place à un BO3 de la qualification pour les quarts de finale. De son côté, CFO recule à 1-2 et n’a désormais plus le droit à l’erreur.

T1 SONT TROP AU DESSUS EN TEAMFIGHT ! pic.twitter.com/F5zm8JsVuA

Même situation pour la Karmine Corp, battue par Bilibili Gaming dans un duel particulièrement disputé. Après leur défaite inaugurale contre Movistar KOI, les vice-champions de LPL ont confirmé leur retour en forme face aux Français. Pourtant, la KC a longtemps tenu tête à son adversaire, avant de craquer lors d’un teamfight décisif autour du Nashor à la 35e minute. Solide dans son duel face à Caliste, Viper a fait la différence sur Kai’Sa (5/1/6), décrochant le titre de MVP. Désormais à 1-2, les hommes de Reapered devront impérativement remporter leurs deux prochains BO3 pour espérer atteindre les quarts de finale.

QUEL TEAMFIGHT DE BLG, CLEAN ACE ! pic.twitter.com/ykHCJfsGvM

Les deux dernières rencontres de la soirée étaient déjà synonymes de survie dans le tournoi. Secret Whales est ainsi devenue la première équipe éliminée de ces Worlds 2026, après une défaite 2-0 face aux Brésiliens de LOS. Plus efficaces dans les teamfights, les champions du CBLOL ont notamment pu compter sur un excellent ZEST et son Kennen (9/2/5) dans la seconde manche. Un succès qui leur permet de rester en vie après deux premières journées compliquées.

Mais le véritable coup de tonnerre est venu de l’élimination d’Anyone’s Legend, champion de LPL, balayé 2-0 par Team Liquid. Les Chinois quittent les Worlds avec un bilan catastrophique de 0-3, sans avoir remporté la moindre rencontre. Dominés dans la jungle par Josedeodo, ils ont d’abord subi une véritable correction en 33 minutes, avec un Morgan impérial sur Camille (7/1/6). La deuxième manche a offert davantage de suspense, mais après 47 minutes de bataille, Yeon a scellé la victoire américaine grâce à sa Xayah (10/1/4). Team Liquid poursuit donc son aventure à domicile, tandis que Tarzan, Shanks et leurs coéquipiers quittent prématurément la compétition. Une immense désillusion pour l’une des formations chinoises les plus attendues de ces Worlds.

title: Dota 2 Dark Carnival Acts 1 and 2 surpass Crownfall’s longest gap between acts
content:
The gap between Acts 1 and 2 of the Dark Carnival event in Dota 2 has exceeded Crownfall’s longest wait between acts, with players still waiting for Valve to release the next chapter of the ongoing story.

title: Team Yandex takes down Team Liquid to claim the top spot in Group A in PARI Universe
content:
Despite suffering their first match loss at PARI Universe, Team Yandex bounced back in Game 3 to overwhelm Team Liquid, securing first place in Group A and a favorable playoff position.

The series became a must-see for many fans, as this is the first time that Ammar “ATF” Al-Assaf will fight against his former teammate from Team Falcons, Stanislav “Malr1ne” Potorak. Malr1ne recently took a post TI 15 break, and upon his return, he joined Team Liquid after the departure of Michał “Nisha” Jankowski from the organization.

The highly anticipated matchup between ATF and Malr1ne at PARI Universe featured plenty of playful banter, with both players tipping each other and exchanging in-game chat messages during teamfights. Their antics were reminiscent of their usual behavior when they played together on Team Falcons, which has drawn mixed reactions from the Dota 2 community.

However, throughout the best-of-three (Bo3) series, Team Yandex appeared to have the upper hand, with the roster delivering the kind of performance that few teams in the world can match. Unlike Team Liquid, who suffered consecutive losses against GamerLegion and OG, Team Yandex looked to be in top form, having remained undefeated in the tournament before this series.

Team Yandex quickly decimated Team Liquid in Game 1, courtesy of Alimzhan “watson” Islambekov’s Kez with 14 kills and 35.6k damage. In Game 2, ATF used his classic Huskar in an attempt to close the series, but Team Liquid successfully neutralized it with a Naix-Earthshaker combo.

Team Yandex decided to give ATF’s Huskar another shot, this time pairing it with a mid-lane Invoker and carry Tiny. Team Liquid’s lineup had limited options for soaking up damage, with carry Lifestealer (Naix) being the only hero capable of taking heavy hits. Unable to withstand Team Yandex’s burst damage, Team Liquid called GG in under 30 minutes.

title: GTA 6 Ambrosia Guide: Allied Crystal, Final Chapter MC and the Real Town Behind It
content:
GTA 6 Ambrosia is an inland industrial town in central Leonida. It’s built around the Allied Crystal sugar refinery, and the Final Chapter MC biker gang has a strong hold on it. Rockstar describes it as the place where “American industry and old school values still reign supreme.” Its look closely matches Clewiston, the Florida sugar town on the south shore of Lake Okeechobee.

Ambrosia is one of the six regions Rockstar revealed on its official Grand Theft Auto VI website alongside Trailer 2 in May 2025. With the game due out on November 19, 2026, here’s everything confirmed about the town so far, and what’s still guesswork.

Rockstar places Ambrosia “in the heart of Leonida.” That puts it inland, away from the Vice City coast and the Leonida Keys. Fans believe it sits in a wider area called Ambrosia County.

Rockstar hasn’t released a fully labelled map yet, so the town’s exact position and size are still unconfirmed. Official screenshots show flat farmland, sugarcane fields, industrial yards and small-town roads.

title: All Apex Legends ranks explained: Iron, Emerald, Grandmaster, and more
content:
Apex Legends is updating its ranked system in Season 32. Read on for esports.gg’s quick guide on all of the new Apex Legends ranks, how the updated system works, and more.

There are nine ranks in total under Apex Legends’ new system. These are Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Emerald, Diamond, Master, and Grandmaster.

The new Apex Legends ranks are Iron, Emerald, and Grandmaster. While Iron replaces Rookie, Emerald sits between Platinum and Diamond. As for the Grandmaster rank, it sits at the very top of the ladder. The Apex Predator rank is gone, so the top 750 Grandmaster players represent the best of the best.

In Apex Legends Season 32, all players who are Diamond rank and above become part of the Pro-Am League. Meanwhile, Iron to Emerald players compete in the Open League.

The Emerald rank being between Platinum and Diamond acts as the transitional stage between these different leagues. The Emerald rank also helps players who are hard-stuck in their chase to Diamond.

Additionally, while the Open League places more importance on kills, the Pro-Am League weighs placement higher than kills.

title: RLCS : Extra reste fidèle à la Karmine Corp, le retour d’un duo légendaire
content:
La reconstruction de la Karmine Corp sur Rocket League prend forme. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Alexandre « Extra » Paoli devrait conserver son poste d’entraîneur principal pour la saison RLCS 2027. Un choix important pour l’organisation française, contrainte de revoir entièrement ses plans après les départs attendus d’Atow et Vatira vers Gentle Mates. Extra avait lui-même discuté avec cette dernière structure pour suivre ses anciens joueurs, avant de finalement privilégier la continuité avec la KC.

Arrivé à la Karmine Corp après avoir pris sa retraite de joueur en 2025, le Français de 24 ans sort d’une première saison réussie sur le banc. Sous sa direction, la KC a notamment remporté le Major de Paris et atteint le dernier carré des Worlds 2026. Mais son maintien prend une dimension particulière avec l’arrivée attendue d’Evan « M0nkey M00n » Rogez, son ancien coéquipier chez Team BDS. Ensemble, les deux Français avaient remporté les Worlds RLCS 2021-2022, avant de marquer durablement l’histoire de la scène compétitive. Ils pourraient désormais se retrouver dans une configuration inédite, avec Extra dans le rôle d’entraîneur et M0nkey M00n comme leader sur le terrain.

Après avoir envisagé un retrait de Rocket League durant l’intersaison, la Karmine Corp aurait finalement choisi de miser sur un mélange d’expérience et de jeunesse. M0nkey M00n devrait être accompagné d’Attila « bibbaba » Eötvös et de reyyn, deux joueurs de seulement 16 ans, encore peu expérimentés au plus haut niveau. Un pari ambitieux, mais qui permettrait aux deux espoirs d’évoluer aux côtés d’un double champion du monde, sous les ordres d’un entraîneur qui connaît parfaitement son jeu.

Cette nouvelle équipe aurait pour mission de tourner la page d’un effectif historique, également marqué par le départ attendu de juicy vers Geekay Esports. La KC devrait faire ses premiers pas avec ce trio lors du RLCS Kick-Off de Londres en décembre, une compétition à laquelle elle est invitée en tant qu’organisation partenaire. Après une intersaison mouvementée, le club français semble donc avoir trouvé les bases de son nouveau projet, avec des ambitions à reconstruire autour du duo Extra – M0nkey M00n.

title: ENCE Bankruptcy: Why the EZ4ENCE Club Collapsed After 13 Years
content:
Finnish esports organization ENCE is filing for bankruptcy. On October 26, 2026, the board of directors of ENCE eSports Oy confirmed the decision on X, ending a 13-year run that included a Counter-Strike Major final at IEM Katowice 2019 and an IEM Dallas title in 2023. The CS2 roster, ranked 103rd on Valve’s regional standings, is left without an organization.

ENCE posted a farewell message titled “The End of an Era” on its official X account on October 26, 2026. The statement said the board had “made the difficult decision to file for bankruptcy” after 13 years.

Head coach Aleksi “allu” Jalli, who first played for ENCE in 2013, reacted with one word: “Heartbroken.” He said he would share more about himself and the team once things settle.

ENCE has not given an official reason. The public record from 2026 shows an organization that was already shrinking and changing course before the filing.

The results never gave the rebuild breathing room. ENCE has not played an HLTV top-tier (MVP-awarding) event since September 2024, which made it far harder to attract sponsors and invites.

ENCE has not said what will happen to its players. In a Finnish bankruptcy, a court-appointed administrator usually takes over the company’s assets and contracts, so the players are likely to look for new teams in the coming weeks. Treat any move as unconfirmed until the players or a new organization announce it.

title: Steam Down: Players Report Widespread Connection Issues on October 26
content:
According to reports, the popular gaming platform Steam is facing widespread outages as players are reporting difficulties in accessing it. While the core services of the platform remain operational, the connection issue is isolated to logging in when connecting via the desktop application or browser.

Based on data from DownDetector , the initial sign of the outage was logged at 3 PM IST on 26th October, with over 500 users experiencing the same issue within 3 hours. As core functionalities remain unharmed, the true extent of the issue has been hard to pinpoint with limited information at hand.

As users continue to report outages, DownDetector claims “Login” as the most reported issue, followed by “Server Connection” and “Game Launching”. The graphs fail to showcase the exact nature of what Steam users are currently facing, but the increasing number of reports suggests it is continuing to affect more and more gamers. With more than 300 reports recorded in the past hour, it will be hard for the developers to ignore it.

Given that Steam houses millions of users, a few hundred reports in an hour mean that this issue is isolated to a particular region or specific users. Interestingly, SteamDB has reported that Steam Store, Community, Web API, and Connection Managers are functioning as usual, making it harder to point out the exact issue that players are facing.

Assuming that users are having difficulty connecting to the Steam server, the Steam desktop application would allow them to launch games that do not rely on the internet in offline mode. It goes without saying that multiplayer titles like Counter-Strike 2 , Dota , and PUBG will be out of reach until the issue is resolved.

At the time of writing, the number of reports is far too low for Valve to acknowledge the issue or release a statement. Rather, this would get fixed in the backend in no time. Unfortunately, the exact timeline for this to get resolved is not available, but keep an eye on SteamDB or Downdetector if you are facing anything similar.

L’Américain s’apprêterait ainsi à quitter le VCT Americas pour découvrir le championnat EMEA, dans le cadre d’une importante restructuration de l’effectif. Son avenir aurait pourtant pu s’écrire de l’autre côté de l’Atlantique : un accord verbal avait initialement été trouvé avec LYON, mais la non-sélection de la structure mexicaine parmi les équipes partenaires du VCT Americas pour 2027-2028 a finalement changé la donne.

Arrivé chez G2 en 2023 et devenu IGL en 2024, valyn s’est imposé comme l’un des principaux artisans des succès de l’organisation nord-américaine. Sous son leadership, G2 a notamment remporté les trois tournois du VCT Americas en 2025, avant de terminer vice-champion du Masters Bangkok. En 2026, l’équipe a ajouté le Stage 1 Americas à son palmarès et atteint le dernier carré des Champions de Shanghai, où elle a été éliminée par 100 Thieves. Son départ s’inscrit dans une reconstruction plus large chez G2, qui devrait notamment accueillir Sato et kiNgg, ce dernier étant pressenti pour reprendre les responsabilités d’IGL.

title: Dota 2 Reaches Its Highest Concurrent Player Peak Since 2016
content:
Despite being a 13-year-old game, Valve’s Dota 2 remains one of the most popular multiplayer games in the world to this day, consistently ranking among the top titles on Steam Charts with massive player counts.

In fact, the popularity of Dota 2 might be reaching an all-time high, as the game is nearing a whopping 1.1 million active concurrent player peak for the first time in a decade . As per data from Steam Charts , the MOBA recorded a peak concurrent player count of 1,096,364 players on October 25, 2026 , second only to Counter-Strike 2, which had a peak of just over 1.3 million active players.

The last time Dota 2 reached these kinds of numbers was back in 2016, when the game reached its all-time player peak of 1.29 million . This sudden surge of Dota 2 players ten years later is certainly surprising, but a welcome sight for any avid fans of the title.

If Dota 2 continues to grow at this pace, it’s only a matter of time before the title surpasses its all-time peak and sets a new milestone for itself.

Dota 2 reached 1,082,982 concurrent players for the first time since 2016. I guess the game isn't that dead after all… pic.twitter.com/2qEMXrfwUr

The exact reason behind the sudden influx of Dota 2 players is still unclear, with some players claiming that bots are taking up a good chunk of the player count. However, it’s also worth mentioning that over the past few months, Valve has given players plenty of reasons to return and for newbies to give Dota 2 a try by providing a steady stream of updates to the game.

Nous avons vécu nos premiers Masters grâce à eux ! Une page de notre histoire s'est écrite à leurs côtés. Merci pour cette année en VCT pic.twitter.com/SGDnLqnRih

Dans un message publié sur les réseaux sociaux, marteen a remercié les supporters pour leur fidélité, tout en évoquant des difficultés au sein de l’équipe. « Que l’année se passe bien ou mal, vous avez toujours été derrière nous et je ne pourrai jamais assez vous remercier. C’est triste que tous ces souvenirs s’arrêtent ici, mais les problèmes internes étaient devenus trop importants pour que je puisse simplement faire comme si tout allait bien et les accepter » , a notamment confié le joueur tchèque.

Ces déclarations font écho à de précédentes prises de parole de marteen. En septembre, lors d’un stream d’Andre « Shao » Sholokhov, il avait déjà accusé une personne d’avoir volontairement fait fuiter certaines informations pour lui nuire. Sans donner davantage de détails, il avait laissé entendre qu’il pourrait revenir sur ces tensions une fois son contrat terminé. Gentle Mates devra désormais reconstruire entièrement son effectif pour 2027, alors que le club a été retenu parmi les équipes partenaires du VCT EMEA pour les deux prochaines saisons. Quant à marteen et Minny, tous deux annoncés dans le viseur de Fnatic, leur avenir reste à officialiser. Le mercato devrait s’accélérer à partir du 2 novembre.

Didnt matter if the year was going well or badly, you guys always had our backs and I cant thank you enough to everyone who supported the team this year. I saw all the messages and it warms my heart. It sucks for all the memories to end here, but the internal issues were too…

title: Canna voit grand pour les équipes LEC : « On peut même atteindre la finale »
content:
Après son exploit contre Anyone’s Legend, la Karmine Corp a connu un premier coup d’arrêt face à LYON lors du deuxième tour du Swiss Stage. Une défaite frustrante pour les Français, qui avaient pourtant réussi à prendre l’avantage avant de céder dans les combats décisifs. Interrogé par Sheep Esports après la rencontre, Kim « Canna » Chang-dong est revenu sur les difficultés rencontrées par son équipe. « Je pense que les dragons ont été le facteur le plus important de cette partie. Nous avons bien réagi lors du premier combat autour du troisième dragon, mais nous avons été déçus par la façon dont le combat suivant s’est déroulé. Cela nous a mis dans une position beaucoup plus difficile. » Le Coréen estime toutefois que la différence entre les deux formations s’est surtout jouée sur des détails, sans constater d’écart majeur de niveau entre LYON et Anyone’s Legend, pourtant champion de Chine en titre.

Mais au-delà de cette défaite, Canna se montre particulièrement optimiste concernant les chances européennes dans ce Mondial. Alors que KOI a débuté le Swiss Stage avec deux victoires et que G2 tente de retrouver son meilleur niveau, le joueur de la KC estime que les représentants du LEC peuvent viser très haut. « Je pense qu’il y a beaucoup de très bonnes équipes cette année. Atteindre les demi-finales, voire aller encore plus loin, est une possibilité réaliste. Et si elles jouent à leur meilleur niveau, je pense qu’elles pourraient même atteindre la finale. » Une déclaration ambitieuse de la part d’un joueur qui connaît parfaitement le niveau des meilleures formations coréennes, après ses passages chez T1 et Dplus KIA.

Cette confiance tranche avec les premières impressions de Canna lors de son arrivée en Europe. Le toplaner reconnaît avoir initialement sous-estimé le niveau de la région, avant de revoir progressivement son jugement. « Quand je suis arrivé en Europe, je ne trouvais pas le niveau général particulièrement élevé. Mais depuis que je suis ici, j’ai le sentiment que le championnat n’a cessé de progresser. » Il souligne également que plusieurs équipes absentes des Worlds possèdent, selon lui, le potentiel pour briller sur la scène internationale, preuve de la progression globale du LEC.

Un constat encourageant pour les supporters européens, même si la route reste longue avant d’envisager une place dans le dernier carré. La Karmine Corp devra d’abord rebondir face à Bilibili Gaming ce lundi, dans une rencontre importante pour la suite de son Swiss Stage. Après avoir déjà fait tomber le premier seed chinois, Canna et ses coéquipiers auront une nouvelle occasion de démontrer que les ambitions européennes ne se limitent pas aux déclarations.

title: Does Shirrako Have GTA 6 Early? What We Know About the Rumoured Rockstar NDA Breach
content:
Popular YouTuber Shirrako has sparked rumours that GTA 6 is already in creators’ hands after a cryptic post on X that fans read as a hint he has early access. Russian outlet iXBT.games went further, suggesting he may have broken an agreement with Rockstar. So far, though, nobody has shown that Shirrako has the game, and he has not posted any GTA 6 footage. Rockstar has not commented.

Here is what he posted, what is known about GTA 6 review copies and the embargo, and how to avoid spoilers before the November 19 launch.

Shirrako runs a YouTube channel known for full, no-commentary walkthroughs of big games, often uploaded the moment early access or a review embargo lifts. Notebookcheck puts the channel at around 2.6 million subscribers.

On his X account , he posted a message made of a game controller emoji and a palm tree emoji. Fans took the palm tree as a reference to Vice City and flooded the replies, asking for gameplay, frame rates on PS5 Pro and whether the weapon wheel had been changed. He did not answer those questions with footage or screenshots.

That is the full extent of the evidence. The post does not mention GTA 6 by name, and neither Shirrako nor Rockstar has confirmed that he received a copy.

There is no proof that he did. iXBT.games framed the story around a possible breach, noting that anyone given early access normally signs a strict confidentiality agreement with heavy penalties for leaks. That part is standard practice across the industry, and Rockstar is known for guarding its games closely.

title: GTA 6 Will Have Hundreds of Explorable Interiors, Rockstar Confirms
content:
GTA 6 will have hundreds of interiors that players can walk into and explore, according to Rockstar. The figure came out of a studio demo at Rockstar North that Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier attended, where the developers said there are “hundreds” of these little spaces to find. It is one of the clearest upgrades over GTA 5, where most of Los Santos sat behind closed doors.

Rockstar has not given an exact number. Here is what the studio has said, what the demo showed and how the interiors tie into robberies.

“Hundreds” is as precise as Rockstar has been. During the Bloomberg demo, a Rockstar developer described “so many of these little interiors” that players can explore, putting the count in the hundreds. Any specific figure you see online beyond that, including lists claiming 700 or more enterable buildings, is fan speculation and not something Rockstar has confirmed.

The studio also stressed how those rooms were built. In an August interview with The New York Times, Rockstar North’s Aaron Garbut said that someone thought about every room in the game, down to who is sitting where and the marks left on a table. That points to interiors designed one by one, as opposed to copied from a template.

GTA 5 had plenty of buildings, but most were facades. You could enter a handful of shops, safehouses, mission locations and a few set pieces, and the rest of the city stayed shut. Rockstar has never published an official count for GTA 5, so we are not putting a number on it, but anyone who played it knows how often a door led nowhere.

The map is the less dramatic part of the jump. Reports from the previews suggest Leonida is not hugely larger than Los Santos and Blaine County, and most of the extra work went into density: narrower roads, more buildings and more of them open to the player. title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II Is Among the Best-Selling Games of 2026, 14 Years After Launch
content:
Call of Duty: Black Ops II, a game that first launched in November 2012, is the sixth best-selling game of 2026 in the US so far. Circana’s year-to-date chart through September puts it ahead of Forza Horizon 6, Tomodachi Life and Pokemon Pokopia, almost entirely on the back of the PS4 and PS5 port that Activision released on July 9. Those new PlayStation versions sent a 14-year-old shooter to the top of the US monthly chart in July.

Here is where it sits, how it got there so fast and why it matters for Call of Duty.

These are Circana’s projected US best-sellers for January to September 2026, ranked by dollar sales across physical and full-game digital purchases. Mobile games and add-on content are not counted.

Marvel’s Wolverine, which topped September after launching mid-month, sits 11th for the year. We covered that launch and the PS5 hardware bump in our September Circana breakdown .

Because PlayStation owners could not buy it before July. Black Ops II originally came out on PS3, Xbox 360, PC and Wii U, and the PS3 version never ran on PS4 or PS5. Xbox players kept access through backward compatibility, and PC players through Steam. Anyone on a modern PlayStation was locked out for over a decade.

Activision fixed that on July 9 with surprise PS4 and PS5 releases of both Black Ops and Black Ops II. Treyarch and Iron Galaxy handled the ports. Each game includes the campaign, multiplayer and Zombies, while the original map packs are sold separately through a season pass. Launch pricing was $19.99 per game until August 6, after which the standard price became $39.99.

title: Legacy save three map points on Mirage, then beat DENDELE 2-0 in double overtime
content:
A day after a four-overtime defeat to Nemiga, Legacy came out on the right side of extra rounds. They won DENDELE’s Cache pick 13-9, recovered from 9-12 on their own Mirage and closed it 19-17, with try finishing the series 59-33. DENDELE have lost all four of their maps in Bucharest, and their tournament now hangs on a single best-of-three.

Overtime was where Legacy ‘s tournament had started to go wrong. On Saturday they lost a 48-round Ancient to Nemiga, 25-23 after four extra periods, and with it their opening match at PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 . On Sunday they went back into overtime on Mirage, and this time the last round was theirs.

It nearly did not get that far. DENDELE led Legacy’s own map pick 12-9 and had three chances to send the series to a decider on Ancient. Legacy won the next three rounds, then needed two overtimes to finish it. The 2-0 ends a run of three straight series defeats.

For 21 rounds, Mirage belonged to the underdogs. Legacy took both pistol rounds, but DENDELE won more of the rifle rounds. They held Legacy’s B hits again and again, with maxxkor’s AWP covering the site, and went into the break 7-5 up on the CT side. Legacy looked flat. Their B hits kept running into stacked defences, the individual duels went the wrong way, and several rounds ran down to the last seconds before being lost.

DENDELE kept that edge after the switch and reached 12-9. What followed was the stretch that decided the series. Legacy won three rounds in a row to force overtime, and their AWPer finally took over. try had been quiet for long spells of regulation; in overtime he won the duels that mattered, several of them against maxxkor, his Argentine counterpart on the other side.

The first overtime still went back and forth. Legacy reached two match points at 15-13, and DENDELE saved both, with rdnzao winning the round that forced a second extra period. In the second, Legacy won a round that had started two against four, with try finishing it in a one-against-one against maxxkor. Legacy went 18-16 up for two more match points, rdnzao denied one of them, and Legacy closed the map 19-17.

title: NAVI upend FURIA 2-0, winning on Ancient at last and on FURIA’s own Dust2 pick
content:
NAVI picked a map they had lost three times running and won it 13-10, then took FURIA’s Dust2 13-5 after a 9-3 first half on defence. b1t finished the series 35-20 a day after going 40-45 against G2, and NAVI are one win from the playoffs at PGL Masters Bucharest.

When NAVI named Ancient as their map, the analysis desk at PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 was puzzled. NAVI had played it three times in recent months and lost all three, 9-13 to The MongolZ, 2-13 to Legacy and 6-13 to G2. FURIA , who win half of their Ancient maps, could have picked it themselves.

FURIA’s answer was Dust2, the map where they had beaten NAVI 13-4 at IEM Rio and 13-6 at IEM Kraków this year, against a team that had played it just once in three months, in Saturday’s triple-overtime win over G2. On paper, the third-ranked team in the world had two comfortable maps lined up. On the server, FURIA were 1-7 down at the start of both.

The pick made sense once the map started. NAVI’s plan ran through mid, where makazze kept opening rounds for his team on the T side, and through fast calls from Aleksib that sent NAVI to A one round and straight to B the next. They led 7-1 and went into the break 8-4 up. It could have been 9-3: in the last round of the half, KSCERATO took three kills to win a two-against-three after iM turned to look at Cave and left the smoke he was meant to watch.

FURIA then did what FURIA do. They won the second pistol round, took five in a row, and attacked NAVI’s B site again and again, with YEKINDAR finding a four-kill round with a MAC-10 and slipping behind the defence in another. From 8-4 down, FURIA led 10-9.

NAVI won the last four rounds. A missed AWP shot from molodoy let w0nderful tie it at 10, three teammates rotated in time to save w0nderful’s site in the next round, and NAVI closed it out with the same aggressive mid setup they had tried a few rounds earlier. It was their first Ancient win in more than three months.

title: What If Team SouL Wins BMIC 2026? Every PMGC Qualification Scenario Explained
content:
If Team SouL wins BMIC 2026, the champion’s PMGC 2026 Gauntlet slot drops to the runner-up, because SouL already holds a Gauntlet spot from winning BMSD 2026. The runner-up’s Group Stage slot then moves to the third-placed team, or further down if that team has already qualified.

That one rule explains most of the confusion around BMIC 2026. Three of the 16 teams in Mumbai already hold PMGC places, so the final standings on November 1 won’t always match who actually flies to the PMGC. A team finishing fourth or even fifth could qualify. We’ve gone through every realistic scenario below using the real BMIC 2026 field.

BMIC 2026 hands out two PUBG Mobile Global Championship (PMGC) 2026 places directly. The champion gets a Gauntlet Stage spot and the runner-up gets a Group Stage spot.

The Gauntlet is the better ticket. Teams there get a faster route to the PMGC Grand Finals, while Group Stage teams have a longer path. That’s why teams that already hold a Group Stage slot still have something to play for in Mumbai. Winning BMIC upgrades them.

The other rule to remember is simple. One team can hold only one PMGC qualification. When a team earns a slot it already has, the spare slot moves to the next eligible team.

All 16 teams play one lobby across 18 matches from October 30 to November 1, 2026, at The Dome, SVP Stadium (NSCI) in Mumbai, with points carrying over each day. The BMIC 2026 page on Liquipedia tracks the live standings, and our BMIC 2026 rosters and qualifiers list has every team and player.

For five rounds on Sunday, The MongolZ looked like the team that arrived at PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 with a trophy from Belgrade and a win over the defending champions. They led 5-0 on Inferno, their own pick, and ZywOo had not registered a kill.

Then the series turned into something else. Team Vitality took 26 of the remaining 30 rounds, won Inferno 13-6 and Cache 13-3, and ZywOo finished with 35 kills and 16 deaths at 114.1 ADR. It was Vitality’s second straight 2-0 without apEX .

Vitality are one win away from the playoffs 🇷🇴 @TeamVitalityCS beat @1mongolz 2-0 in Stream A Vitality move to 2W-0L; The MongolZ fall to 1W-1L #PGLMasters pic.twitter.com/ETkX4nFW3z

The MongolZ came in with an idea for their T side on Inferno, and it worked at first. They showed heavy pressure towards one site, held it, then pivoted late to the other, the same baiting style that had troubled Aurora on Saturday. Vitality’s defence kept turning the wrong way. The MongolZ won the pistol round and the follow-up buys, and in round five 910 won a one-against-two against jL and flameZ with two quick swings.

Vitality called a timeout at 0-5. What followed was ten rounds in a row, and most of them went through ZywOo. He took four kills on the A site in the first of them, four more with the AWP on B in the next, and then won a one-against-two that summed up the problem for The MongolZ. With the bomb dropped and time to plant, two MongolZ players hesitated as ZywOo flashed from the CT spawn to announce himself, then ran the long way round and caught them from behind. The respect he gets in those spots is half the reason he wins them, and The MongolZ gave him every second he needed.

title: How Many GTA 6 Pre-Orders Have Been Sold? Every Estimate So Far

The figure covers digital pre-orders on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S up to October 20, 2026, and puts revenue at roughly $630 million with less than four weeks left before the November 19 launch.

Take-Two has not shared a single official unit number. So every count you have seen online traces back to Sensor Tower’s tracker, which has been updated in steps since pre-orders opened on June 25. Below, we have lined up every estimate in order, worked out what the pace means for launch week, and separated what is confirmed from what is modelled.

Sensor Tower’s most recent estimate puts GTA 6 at about 6.45 million digital pre-orders and $630 million in revenue as of October 20, 2026. The PS5 accounts for about 4.8 million of those copies ($468 million), and Xbox Series X|S for about 1.66 million ($162 million). That is a 74/26 split in Sony’s favour.

One week earlier, on October 13, the same tracker had GTA 6 at just over 6 million units and about $594 million. That jump of roughly 370,000 copies in seven days shows demand still building as launch gets closer.

Our first report on these numbers, GTA 6 pre-orders crossing an estimated $630 million , covers the revenue side in detail. This page tracks the unit count over time and will be updated as new data lands.

title: PS5 Sales Jump 22% in the US as Marvel’s Wolverine Tops September Charts Ahead of GTA 6
content:
PS5 sales in the United States rose 22% year over year in September 2026, according to Circana data shared by analyst Mat Piscatella on October 22. Dollar sales climbed even faster, up 43%. That made the PS5 the best-selling console of the month in both units and revenue, and it happened during the same five-week window in which Marvel’s Wolverine launched and the hype for GTA 6 kept building.

So which one moved the needle? Probably both. The numbers give a clearer answer than you might expect, though, and they also say a lot about what November could look like for Sony, Microsoft and Nintendo.

Circana’s September period ran for five weeks, from August 30 to October 3, 2026. All figures are US-only projections, and the hardware comparisons are against the same period in 2025.

The gap between units and dollars is the interesting part. PS5 revenue grew roughly twice as fast as the number of consoles sold, which means each buyer spent a lot more. Tech Insider, working from the Circana breakdown, puts the average PS5 price paid at about $646, up 17%. Kotaku notes that an all-digital PS5 now costs $600 in the US. People are paying more per box and still buying.

Overall US spending on games, hardware and accessories slipped 1% to $4.8 billion for the period, as Kotaku reported . Year to date, spending sits at $41.0 billion, 3% behind 2025.

One month earlier the picture looked grim. In Circana’s August 2026 report, PlayStation hardware units fell 11% and hit their lowest August since 2013, while Xbox dropped 31%, according to Gaming.net’s breakdown of Piscatella’s data. The average console price in the US was also at a record high. Piscatella said at the time that price sensitivity was becoming a real problem.

title: flameZ climbs out of a 0-8 hole on Cache to take apEX-less Vitality past 9z 2-0
content:
ZywOo and flameZ both started Cache 0-8 and Vitality fell 4-7 behind on their own map pick, then won it 13-10 to finish a 2-0 series in which jL took the first of five steps towards a Major sticker.

For nine rounds of Cache, ZywOo did not register a kill. flameZ had also started the map 0-8. It was the map Team Vitality had picked, one they had won seven of their previous eight times, and 9z led 6-2 on it.

Vitality still won it 13-10. flameZ finished Cache with 22 kills, 13 deaths and 100.2 ADR, almost all of it on the CT side after the break, and the 2-0 win over 9z gives the top seed a clean start at PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 in their first series without apEX .

Cache was supposed to be ZywOo’s map, and Vitality went into the series with an 88% win rate on it over the previous three months. 9z took that away early. They won the pistol round, went 4-0 up and never let Vitality break their control of mid, which left the attack with little but direct hits on the sites, straight into 9z’s layered setups.

The CT side was a different map. Vitality won the second pistol round, and flameZ took over the middle of the map on the rounds that followed as Vitality levelled at 7-7 and went ahead. title: syph0 drags Nemiga through four overtimes in 2-0 win over Legacy
content:
Nemiga needed four overtimes and a 47-kill map from syph0 to win their own pick against last year’s Bucharest finalists, then took Dust2 13-8 for a sweep that leaves them on the edge of a Singapore Major spot.

Nemiga ‘s first match at PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 ended in a sweep of Legacy . Ancient, their own pick, ran to a fourth overtime before they took it 25-23, and Legacy’s Dust2 followed 13-8.

Legacy came in as clear favourites. They are eighth in Valve’s Regional Standings, reached the final in Bucharest a year ago, where they lost 3-2 to Aurora, and their Major place was never in doubt. Nemiga were 23rd and came through the European closed qualifier. For them, this was the match that mattered most of the whole event. Before the series, HLTV’s simulation gave them an 80.5% chance of an invite to the PGL Major Singapore, rising to 96.9% with a win.

The series was decided on a map that refused to end. Ancient is Nemiga’s most played map, and they had it won several times over. They led 12-9 and had three map points in regulation. Legacy saved all three and kept going, six rounds in a row in all, to stand on map point themselves at 15-12 in the first overtime. Nemiga came back to force a second overtime, then a third, then a fourth.

Legacy survived on clutches. latto won three of them on the map and dumau two, and every time Nemiga looked ready to close, a Legacy player on low health found another headshot. Nemiga’s habit of forcing the pace, which won them rounds early, became predictable deep into the overtimes, and Legacy started to wait for the fights to come to them.

Nemiga still found the answers when it counted. Xant3r, quiet for most of the map, won a one-against-two by sitting on the bomb when nobody expected him there. In the fourth overtime Legacy saved one more map point at 24-22, before Nemiga finally closed it out 25-23 in round 48.

title: BetBoom stun world number one Spirit 2-1 as zorte’s AWP clutch ends Mirage in overtime
content:
BetBoom beat Team Spirit 13-3 on Spirit’s own Ancient pick, came back from 4-8 on Mirage and closed the series with a one-against-three from zorte, while donk had one of the worst series of his year.

Team Spirit arrived at PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 as the top-ranked team in the world on HLTV and lost their first match 2-1 to BetBoom on Saturday. Spirit won BetBoom’s pick Anubis 13-10, but BetBoom answered with 13-3 on Ancient and a 16-14 overtime win on Mirage.

Spirit arrived as the number one team in the world on HLTV and clear favourites. BetBoom came straight from Malta, where they lost the Thunderpick World Championship final 2-3 to FURIA last Sunday after leading the series 2-1. Bucharest was their chance to show that Malta was not a one-off. They leave the first day with the biggest scalp in the tournament.

The last round of the series belonged to zorte. BetBoom had two map points in regulation, at 12-10 and 12-11, and two more in overtime at 15-13 and 15-14. Spirit saved the first three. On the fourth, zorte was left alone with an AWP against three Spirit players. He killed one with a no-scope, switched to his pistol and finished the other two to close Mirage 16-14.

It capped his best series in a long time. He finished with 57 kills and 37 deaths, the most kills and the best K-D in the match by a distance, and 87% KAST. On Ancient he went 14-4 with 106.2 ADR. zorte had not put up big numbers for some time before Malta, but he was one of BetBoom’s best players there, and in Bucharest he carried that over against the best team in the world.

He was not alone. Every BetBoom player except Boombl4 and Magnojez finished with more kills than deaths, and the in-game leader made up for his numbers with the calling. Boombl4 had ten kills before Spirit won a single round on Ancient. He also outcalled magixx over the series, most clearly on Ancient, and kept BetBoom calm when the decider slipped into overtime.

title: Aurora’s title defence starts with a 2-1 loss to The MongolZ

Defending champions Aurora are 0-1 at PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 after a 2-1 loss to The MongolZ on Saturday morning. Aurora took Inferno 16-12 in overtime, but The MongolZ hit back with 13-2 on Nuke and 13-9 on Dust2.

The MongolZ came in as clear underdogs. Aurora are fifth in Valve’s Regional Standings, have finished in the top three at each of their last three events and won this tournament a year ago. The MongolZ were 23rd, playing at 09:00 in Bucharest after a grand final in Belgrade on Thursday night, and with a lineup that has been together for less than three weeks.

Inferno was The MongolZ’ pick, and for a long time it looked like the map they would lose the series on. They won the pistol and led 4-1, but Aurora won six rounds in a row and went into the half 7-5 up. In the second half Aurora reached 12-9 with three map points, before The MongolZ won three straight rounds to force overtime.

There, Aurora were the better team. Wicadia, who finished Inferno with 26 kills and 108.2 ADR, had five kills in the last two rounds, and at 13-12 Jimpphat won a two-against-three round on B by waiting inside a smoke with the AWP. Aurora won overtime 4-0.

Losing your own map pick after saving three map points is the kind of result that can end a series. It was the one scenario The MongolZ could not afford: with Nuke, one of their weakest maps, coming next, they had to win Inferno.

title: LEC : 3XA de retour chez SK Gaming
content:

title: apEX’s Major sticker and Astralis’ invite on the line as PGL Masters Bucharest begins
content:
PGL Masters Bucharest is the last tier-one event before Valve sets the invitations for PGL Major Singapore. Beyond the $1,250,000 title, two roster questions will be settled by a simple count: Vitality need five matches with jL for him to replace apEX on their Major roster, and FUT need five with SunPayus to remove cmtry, now an Astralis player, from theirs.

The Swiss stage starts on Saturday 09:00 CEST , when FUT open against TYLOO and defending champions Aurora face The MongolZ . Sixteen teams play in PGL’s studio until the grand final on 31 October. Two days later, on 2 November, Valve’s Regional Standings decide who is invited to which stage of the Major in Singapore, which starts on 24 November.

For most of the field, the Major invite is already safe. What is still open is who goes straight to Stage 3, who has to play more rounds, and, for two teams, which five players the invitation will actually name.

Valve’s Regional Standings do not rank organisations. They rank rosters, and Valve’s published code sets out how a roster is defined. The model looks at a team’s last ten matches and includes “only the most recent players who have played five or more matches on this roster”. A team is still treated as the same team as long as at least three players carry over, so a single stand-in or signing does not reset its points.

In practice, a new player needs five of the last ten matches before he replaces the player he came in for. Until then, the name of the departed player stays on the roster that gets the invitation.

The latest official standings, published by Valve on 5 October, list Vitality as apEX, flameZ, mezii, ropz and ZywOo, and FUT as cmtry, dem0n, dziugss, Krabeni and xfl0ud. Valve’s Major Supplemental Rulebook states that “invitations will be sent to intact rosters” and that the roster a team registers “must match the invited roster”. A team may add one substitute and one coach.

title: Exclusive: MLBB at 10, From Niche Mobile MOBA to Global Esports Powerhouse

Ten years later, Quan leads the MLBB Battlefield Business at MOONTON Games, overseeing the game’s in-match combat experience. As the title celebrates its 10th anniversary, he sees its evolution as something more personal, something akin to “celebrating a birthday with a long-time companion.”

title: How to Play Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer Early With the New Zealand Trick
content:
You can play Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer early on console by switching your region to New Zealand. Console multiplayer unlocks at midnight local time on October 23, and New Zealand reaches midnight before anyone else, at 11:00 UTC on October 22. On the US East Coast, that works out to a 17-hour head start.

The trick works best on Xbox and through the Xbox app on PC. Steam and Battle.net players are out of luck because PC unlocks at one moment worldwide. PlayStation is possible, but it costs you a second account.

Console players get multiplayer at 12:00 AM local time on October 23. New Zealand has been on daylight saving time (NZDT, UTC+13) since late September, which is why its midnight lands at 11:00 UTC on October 22.

Some guides list the New Zealand unlock as 6:00 AM on October 21. That is wrong. The table below shows what time New Zealand’s unlock hits in your zone, and how many hours you gain over waiting for your own midnight.
